rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete template: both are short diplomatic congratulations addressed to a newly invested national leader, opening with nearly the same occasion-and-investiture formula, extending greetings and congratulations, and then expressing hopes for favorable conditions and closer bilateral relations before a brief complimentary close. C22 and C09 share the congratulation-on-becoming-prime-minister function, but their language and structure are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish to convey my sincere greetings and best wishes ... and to congratulate you on the occasion of your reappointment and investiture as Prime Minister of Greece.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On the occasion of your investiture as Governor General of the Federation of Nigeria, it gives me great pleasure to extend to you ... cordial greetings and heartiest congratulations.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel opening machinery combines the occasion of investiture with greetings and congratulations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that ... our two nations will continue to work together in the spirit of firm friendship which has traditionally characterized Greek and American relations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I know that ... your years in this high office will be marked by peace and prosperity for your people and by ever-closer relations between Nigeria and the United States.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow the congratulations with confidence or hope for the leader's tenure and strengthened bilateral relations.
